about.bio:
I'm Sarp Susüzer, a design engineer working globally. I started as an industrial designer, moved into UI/UX, and now work on various products.

I run [Studio Magik](https://studiomagik.com), an embedded design and dev studio for startups, where we use AI to ship product design, branding and Framer builds faster. I care about calm interfaces, clear hierarchy and cutting what doesn't earn its place.

"Become as good as the problem you're solving."
